verdict.rationale: Stable documents a REST API with per-endpoint reference pages and publishes an llms.txt, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate URL. The llms.txt is a documentation index, not an API spec, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
